dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Non-ketotic hyperglycemia-induced hemichorea-hemiballismus (due to striatal toxicity from severe uncontrolled diabetes mellitus)

Alternatives:
1. Hemichorea secondary to the lacunar infarct affecting the basal ganglia
2. Early neurodegenerative chorea (e.g., Wilson disease or other chorea spectrum disorder) with coincidental uncontrolled diabetes
3. Hemiparkinsonism from a subclinical contralateral basal ganglia lesion
